messages:
tim.billing: Heads-up — inbound EUR transfer hit our account with no remittance. IBAN DE89370400440532013000, amount 12,540.00 EUR, value date 2024-11-05. Beneficiary name matches CloudForms GmbH but no PO/invoice ref. Please do not auto-apply.

maria.finance: Got it. Can you paste the full payment row from the bank feed (booking id, ordering bank, any sender name)? We need the exact fields for a trace/MT199 if the customer can't produce remittance.

tim.billing: Sure — pasted from bank CSV: ```booking_id: 721-9921-DEB, value_date: 2024-11-05, amount: 12540.00 EUR, counterparty_name: CloudForms GmbH, ordering_bank: Commerzbank AG, originating_bic: DEUTDEFFXXX, remittance_info: ""```

sam.support: I'm pinging the customer now asking for a bank statement or SWIFT copy showing the ordering reference. @maria.finance — should we hold allocation while we wait?

maria.finance: Yes, do not apply. Hold in Unallocated AR. If customer can't provide supporting remittance within 48h we will open a formal trace with our correspondent. I'll prepare the details for the bank: booking id + amount + value date + ordering bank.

bank-ops-bot: Bank ticket created: BT-7654 — MT199 trace request queued to correspondent bank (Commerzbank AG). Estimated turnaround 48-72h.

oliver.ops: If the trace comes back inconclusive we should have a policy to temporarily credit to a suspense account and add a note for reversal on match. Also flag VAT: the invoice we have is missing seller VAT ID — that could block reconciliation. @tim.billing any compliance concerns?

tim.billing: Agree on suspense account flow. For VAT, ask customer for corrected invoice (with VAT ID) before final allocation. If trace confirms payer intended this invoice, we'll post and adjust.

maria.finance: I'll attach these instructions to BT-7654 and ask bank to include the full MT chain. Please keep any SWIFT/statement copies in this thread.

sam.support: Customer replied: "We ran a sweep and our ERP stripped the payment reference. We'll pull a SWIFT copy and send within 24h." :+1:

tim.billing: Good — once we have the SWIFT copy we can match and release from suspense. Leaving thread open until matched.
